class.name: SoundPropagation
class.brief_description: Deterministic sound propagation budget for authoritative AI hearing.
class.description: Calculates the range of a server-issued sound event after wind and geometric obstruction. Quiet sources (such as footsteps) lose more hearing range behind an obstacle than louder sources (such as shots). This class deliberately does not perform physics queries or modify the audio mixer. Use the same world geometry as projectiles and enemy visibility to decide whether an obstruction exists, and call [method effective_radius] only when the sound lies near the detection boundary. An engine build without this module can use the equivalent GDScript policy.

method.name: effective_radius
method.description: Returns the hearing range, in meters, from an original server-owned source radius and an already wind-adjusted range (including pursuit leash). If [param blocked] is [code]true[/code], attenuates quiet sounds to 62% and loud sounds to at most 80%. An open path keeps the wind-adjusted range. Invalid or silent inputs return zero. This method never expands the detection range.

method.name: travel_delay_seconds
method.description: Computes the arrival delay of an audible event from the distance between the source and listener at the given air temperature, using an approximate speed of sound of [code]331.3 + 0.606 * temperature_c[/code] meters/second. Intended for flashes and delayed thunder, explosions over distance, or other events where sound arrives after the visual impact. Events outside [code]0..2400[/code] meters, temperatures outside [code]-40..60[/code] degrees Celsius, and non-finite values return [code]-1.0[/code] (invalid), not a zero-delay event. Does not schedule or play audio.
